facts.text: Pendry Manhattan West is a California-inspired hotel in Midtown Manhattan.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Manhattan West hotel is an understated, California-inspired Midtown destination

facts.text: The hotel is on Manhattan's west side, a 6-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station and a 13-minute walk from the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Manhattan West is located on Manhattan’s west side, a 6-minute walk from Moynihan Train Hall and Penn Station and a 13-minute walk from the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center.

facts.text: Guestroom interiors are by Gachot Studios.
facts.excerpt: each featuring warm, contemporary interiors by world-renowned Gachot Studios

facts.text: The suites have interiors by Gachot Studios, expansive space and skyline views of New York City.
facts.excerpt: 30 Suite style guestrooms feature upscale interiors by world-renowned Gachot Studios with expansive space and stunning skyline views of New York City.

facts.text: The building was designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill, the firm behind the Freedom Tower and Moynihan Train Hall.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Manhattan West was designed by Skidmore, Owings & Merrill—the same firm behind the Freedom Tower and Penn Station’s new Moynihan Train Hall.

facts.text: The facade is made of rippling waves of floor-to-ceiling glass, giving front-facing rooms semi-circle window nooks with panoramic city views.
facts.excerpt: The eye-catching structure is made up of rippling waves of floor-to-ceiling glass windows, giving the front-facing rooms semi-circle window nooks from which to take in the panoramic city views.

facts.text: Every room has floor-to-ceiling windows.
facts.excerpt: Every room features floor-to-ceiling windows

facts.text: The Pendry Suite is a 21st-floor, two-bedroom corner suite with a baby grand piano and a Bowers & Wilkins entertainment system.
facts.excerpt: the Pendry suite, a 21st-floor, two-bedroom corner suite with a baby grand piano and state-of-the-art entertainment system from Bowers & Wilkins

facts.text: Every suite has a standalone bathtub by the windows.
facts.excerpt: There are standalone bath tubs by the windows in every suite

facts.text: Every room has been engineered to block out street noise.
facts.excerpt: Each and every room has been engineered to block out street noise

facts.text: At nightly turndown, Billy Joel and Paul Simon music plays softly in the room.
facts.excerpt: you'll return to gentle Billy Joel and Paul Simon music softly filling both the living area and bedroom wing

facts.text: The hotel has a 24/7 fitness center and Movement Studio with Technogym equipment and Peloton bikes.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Manhattan West features a 24/7, 1,700 square foot Fitness Center and Movement Studio featuring all-new Technogym equipment and Peloton bikes

facts.text: There is no spa on site.
facts.excerpt: There's no spa on site

facts.text: The concierge team recommends outdoor walking and running routes in the neighborhood.
facts.excerpt: Let our Concierge Team point you in the right direction for our favorite outdoor walking and running routes in our Midtown neighborhood and beyond.

facts.text: Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant led by Executive Chef Juliana Latif.
facts.excerpt: Zou Zou’s is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant from some of the most notable culinary names in the city, helmed by Executive Chef Juliana Latif.

facts.text: Bar Pendry sits beneath an abstract gold leaf mural by Nancy Lorenz.
facts.excerpt: beneath an abstract gold leaf Nancy Lorenz mural

facts.text: Chez Zou has a fourth-floor terrace with open-air seating overlooking the plaza.
facts.excerpt: Chez Zou features a fourth-floor terrace patio with open-air seating overlooking the plaza.

facts.text: Dogs up to 60 pounds are welcome for an additional fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes. Pendry Manhattan West welcomes dogs up to 60 pounds for an additional fee.

facts.text: One-bedroom suites can adjoin deluxe king rooms, suiting groups or parents traveling with kids.
facts.excerpt: One-bedroom suites have the option to adjoin to adjacent deluxe king rooms, making them perfect for groups or parents traveling with kids.

facts.text: Check-in begins at 4:00pm and check-out is at 12:00pm.
facts.excerpt: Check-in at Pendry Manhattan West begins at 4:00pm and check-out is at 12:00pm.

facts.text: The eight-acre, mixed-use Manhattan West area has shopping, a variety theater, a Whole Foods Market and restaurants.
facts.excerpt: The eight-acre, mixed-use area of Manhattan West boasts shiny new shopping venues, a variety theater, a Whole Foods Market, and restaurants by the likes of

facts.text: The hotel opened in September 2021 on the site of former open-air train yards.
facts.excerpt: Opened in September 2021 on the site of former open-air train yards

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler named the hotel to its Hot List 2022.
facts.excerpt: Hot List 2022

facts.text: Wedding spaces for parties up to 75 guests include two city-inspired ballrooms, Zou Zou's and the indoor-outdoor Salon & Terrace.
facts.excerpt: signature hotel spaces for parties up to 75 guests, including two intimate city-inspired ballrooms, Zou Zou’s restaurant and the indoor and outdoor Salon & Terrace

facts.text: Rooms and suites look over the city or Manhattan West Plaza, depending on the room.
facts.excerpt: Pendry Manhattan West guestrooms and suites offer views of the city or Manhattan West Plaza, depending on the room or suite selected.

facts.text: One Bedroom Suites have two separate living areas, a walk-in closet with dressing area, a guest washroom and city views.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features two separate living areas, one with a large L-shaped sofa, along with a walk-in closet with dressing area, guest washroom and city views.

facts.text: The Pendry Suite includes a kitchenette with a refrigerator, oven and bar.
facts.excerpt: The Pendry Suite also includes a kitchenette with a refrigerator, oven and bar

facts.text: Chilled and room-temperature water is offered on arrival and departure.
facts.excerpt: Chilled and room-temperature water is offered on arrival and upon departure

facts.text: Vista Lounge on the fourth floor serves daily breakfast.
facts.excerpt: Vista Lounge is a retro-meets-modern dining space on the fourth floor offering daily breakfast for hotel guests and locals alike.

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as having a stunning signature facade and highly personalized luxury service.
facts.excerpt: With the stunning signature façade, airy and relaxed interiors and the highly personalized luxury service and amenities
